title: Original Research
description: A Journeyman's stipend is paid out of a patron's endowment, and the patron who funds yours wants to see it produce something before the year is out - not for its own sake, for the report Elara has to give at the winter council. Pick a specialization - Elemental, Illusion, Necromancy or Enchantment - and put something on paper worth defending, or the endowment goes to next year's Journeyman instead.

objectives.description: Pick the specialization you'll be judged on
objectives.notes: Dialogue choice: Elemental, Illusion, Necromancy, or Enchantment

objectives.description: Gather the materials your research actually needs, on the endowment's coin
Run the experiments that turn materials into a real finding
Write it up as something the council can actually read
Defend it in front of the council whose money paid for it

notes: Threat: an endowment that lapses to someone else if the research produces nothing. Giver motive: Elara has to justify every Journeyman's upkeep to the patron paying for it, at a council session where other Magisters are watching her choices. Consequence: unwired - the quest cannot fail or produce a weak thesis in the data, so the endowment never actually moves. First Journeyman quest; reward depends on chosen specialization.
